entities.name: Syr Joshua
entities.description: An Ardenvale knight of Eldraine, the Beast Tamer, who carries a warhammer; lover of Syr Saxon and companion of Rowan Kenrith.

entities.name: Syr Saxon
entities.description: A ranger of generous heart from Eldraine who carries a bone axe; lover of Syr Joshua.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A companion of Syr Joshua and Syr Saxon.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A curse of which Joshua and Saxon were both victims.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: The knightly order Syr Joshua belongs to.

events.summary: Syr Joshua and Syr Saxon both fall victim to the Wicked Slumber.
events.quote: They were both victims of the Wicked Slumber

relations.note: The two are lovers who fight together.
relations.quote: The two are lovers who fight together

relations.note: The pair are companions of Rowan Kenrith.
